_comment: DECLARED BEFORE ANY WP5 POLICY CODE EXISTED. invariant = must hold exactly; hypothesis = directional expectation on EVALUATION seeds (SUPPORTED/REFUTED; refuted ones are reported); report = measured, no verdict. Finite synthetic runs never prove real-world safety.

thresholds.basis: AST + blocked-import subprocess + object-graph walk of the stack after every run
trust admission refuses age > 0.5 s, invalid, flagged
P1: remote information may only ADD braking (final command <= local-only candidate)
deterministic simulation and decision stack
|a_cmd| <= 6.0 m/s2 and valid mode on every command
no crash
no cryptographic verification exists; trust level 'authenticated' is unreachable
all policies share dt, control step, vehicle parameters, friction and scenario seeds
scenario validity: the hazard must be genuinely hazardous for ego-only nominal
thresholds.hypothesis: scenario is hazardous (not trivially safe)

thresholds.basis: scenario validity: not unavoidable for everyone
thresholds.hypothesis: scenario is not hopeless

thresholds.basis: no-hazard control must be safe
thresholds.hypothesis: control scenario is safe

thresholds.basis: early remote warning gives time to brake
thresholds.hypothesis: E3 halves the ego-only nominal collision rate

thresholds.basis: CCTV sees the pedestrian behind the truck
thresholds.hypothesis: E2 (CCTV) is safer than ego-only nominal

thresholds.basis: V2V camera sees the pedestrian
thresholds.hypothesis: E1 (V2V) is safer than ego-only nominal

thresholds.basis: cooperation should not be worse than the conservative ego-only baseline
thresholds.hypothesis: E3 is non-inferior to conservative ego-only (margin 5 points)

thresholds.basis: occlusion-aware phantom pedestrian slows the ego
thresholds.hypothesis: the conservative baseline is effective

thresholds.basis: earlier braking increases the minimum time-to-collision
thresholds.hypothesis: E3 raises median minimum TTC by >= 0.3 s

thresholds.basis: E3 only slows for REAL remote tracks
thresholds.hypothesis: E3 costs no more travel time than conservative ego-only in the no-hazard control

thresholds.basis: a waiting pedestrian near the lane triggers precaution by design
thresholds.hypothesis: E3 unnecessary interventions <= 30% in the control

thresholds.basis: ghost obstacle + full trust = emergency braking
thresholds.hypothesis: naive cooperation is harmed by a ghost

thresholds.basis: remote-only advisory cap 3.0 m/s2 and contradiction hold
thresholds.hypothesis: guarded cooperation is not harmed by a ghost (no hard braking)

thresholds.basis: naive max braking on a ghost with a following human driver
thresholds.hypothesis: naive ghost braking causes rear-end collisions

thresholds.basis: follower-aware cap
thresholds.hypothesis: guarded cooperation keeps follower collisions <= 5%

thresholds.basis: hazard + follower
thresholds.hypothesis: cooperation does not add rear-end collisions beyond 5 points

thresholds.basis: hazard + follower
thresholds.hypothesis: cooperation helps ego collisions also with a follower present

thresholds.basis: no remote data => identical decisions to E0-N
thresholds.hypothesis: local-only fallback is exactly E0-N when remote traffic is lost

thresholds.basis: degraded link + 0.58 m CCTV bias
thresholds.hypothesis: degraded/biased cooperation is not worse than ego-only nominal

thresholds.basis: ID churn on the remote source
thresholds.hypothesis: ID churn does not make E3 worse than ego-only nominal

thresholds.basis: non-allowlisted source is rejected at admission
thresholds.hypothesis: untrusted-source ghost causes no intervention

thresholds.basis: risk prediction calibration (autocorrelated ticks; provisional)
thresholds.hypothesis: risk model ECE <= 0.15

thresholds.basis: pure-Python stack; sandbox CPU, NOT the Jetson
thresholds.hypothesis: decision latency P95 <= 20 ms on the sandbox

thresholds.basis: 10 Hz publish + 30 ms link + processing
thresholds.hypothesis: remote observation age at decision P95 <= 0.3 s

thresholds.basis: bias creates duplicate ghost tracks (WP4 KF-7)
thresholds.hypothesis: under degraded/biased inputs the naive policy brakes hard more often than the guarded one

thresholds.basis: reported only
thresholds.hypothesis: maximum deceleration

thresholds.basis: reported only
thresholds.hypothesis: maximum jerk (m/s3) - includes the standstill discontinuity

thresholds.basis: KNOWN LIMITATION: the backend snaps acceleration to 0 at v=0; counted, never claimed compliant
thresholds.hypothesis: emergency-stop standstill jerk discontinuity events
